text:
ana (Hiring Manager): Quick favor  new IC (Diego) starts Mon. Can someone craft a short "first-week expectations" blurb + a minimal 30/60/90 I can paste in the welcome email? Also need a tiny manager checklist (what I should do day1-day7).
ben (People Ops): Sure. Keeping it compact and copy/paste ready. Any special infra access?
ana (typo) ana (Hiring Manager): No GPU. Needs repo + staging read, analytics dashboard view. Buddy pairing important.
li (IT): I can queue device imaging. Default ship to SF office. Groups: eng, analytics-view, repo-read. CLI for reprovision:
```
rwctl provision --user diego.m --groups eng,repo-read,analytics-view --device mac-air
```
ben (People Ops): Pasteable first-week blurb:
- Prestart: confirm device + delivery, complete payroll & I-9, accept Slack/SSO invites.
- Day 1: People Ops intro (benefits/ops) 9:30, manager 1:1 11:00 (role + expectations), buddy intro 2:00, quick tour of docs.
- Day 2: product & infra walkthrough, assign tiny starter ticket.
- Day 3: pair programming on starter ticket, docs PR.
- Day 4-5: finish starter, meet cross-functional partners, EOW 30m check-in with manager.
- EOW deliverable: open PR + 3-item learning note.
ben (People Ops): Minimal 30/60/90 for paste (three bullets each):
- 30d: complete onboarding tasks, ship starter PR, finish security training.
- 60d: own a small feature/bug from design to merge, present progress in team demo.
- 90d: lead a minor project, reduce iteration time on own PRs, propose one product improvement.
rachel (Security): Add: 2FA required before any infra creds. Quick security intro Tue 3pm. KMS/HSM access needs manager approval + ticket. Link: <https://security.redwood/onboard>.
onboard-bot: Action created: new-hire packet for diego.m. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO. Due: 2026-04-06 17:00 PT.
nana (ana?) ana (Hiring Manager): Also want a short manager checklist I can keep in a doc. Something like: Day0 prep, Day1: expectations + 1:1, Day2: shadow + give starter, Day3-5: check progress + feedback, Friday: 30-min feedback sync.
ben (People Ops): Manager checklist (copyable):
- Day -1: confirm device & access, add to team calendar, assign buddy.
- Day 1: 11:00 1:1 (roles, priorities, learning plan), intro team at standup, lunch with buddy.
- Day 2: demo product & codebase, hand off starter task, set 7-day goal.
- Day 3: pair review, give actionable feedback, unblock access if needed.
- Day 4: sync with cross-functional partners, check learning progress.
- Day 5: EOW 30-min expectations + feedback sync, set 30-day milestones.
li (IT): Device queued, imaging Mon 07:00 PT. Will post serial once imaged. If you need expedited home delivery DM me.
rachel (Security): Ill post the 5-min security checklist for managers to run before granting infra creds.
nana (ana?) ana (Hiring Manager): Perfect, thanks. Ill paste both into Diegos welcome email and schedule the Friday sync. :raised_hands:
